title: Product Gallery
description: Watch product page where a full-width hero carousel and a thumbnail strip follow each other frame by frame.
steps: The hero pages at full width with `autoplay` every `3000` ms; each watch turns `24°` and shrinks to `0.7` with its `relativeProgress`, and `progress` blends the halo color.
The thumbnails are a second `loop` carousel with `itemSize` 76 and a centering `itemAnimation`; tapping one calls `scrollTo({ index })`.
Both carousels get a `scrollOffsetValue`; an `onBegin` observer from `onConfigurePanGesture` marks which one leads, and a reaction copies its offset to the other, scaled by page size.
